_comment: EXAMPLE extra guard rules, loaded by guard.mjs after the built-in tiers. The installer copies this to policy/guard-rules.json on first run; edit that file freely. Each rule is {decision:'deny'|'ask', pattern:<regex>, message:<string>}, matched against the Bash command. Note the escaping: in JSON, a regex word boundary is \\b and a literal dot is \\.

rules.message: write-method curl is denied by example rule. Use the dedicated API client for state-changing calls, or narrow the request to a read-only verb.
publishing a package is a one-way door: the version cannot be reused. Confirm the registry and the version first.
